header: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background texture for gothic dark fantasy game Heroes of Orvesk. Painterly realistic old materials, fine grain, restrained muted palette, deep charcoal shadows, tactile surface, consistent with worn bronze gothic frames. A flat front-facing material swatch covering the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge. No frame, no border, no scene, no objects, no people, no lettering, no symbols, no decorations. Very low contrast so cream-colored interface text stays readable. No strong spots, seams, checkerboard or repetitive motifs. Opaque image. Asset type: wide 3:1 modal header background. Dark aged bronze and blackened iron, fine brushed abrasion and faint brown-gold patina. Smooth shallow horizontal sheen, subdued charcoal olive undertone. The overall value is DARK, gold visible only as muted patina, no bright metallic stripes. Uniform detail distribution, large shapes absent.
body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background texture for gothic dark fantasy game Heroes of Orvesk. Painterly realistic old materials, fine grain, restrained muted palette, deep charcoal shadows, tactile surface, consistent with worn bronze gothic frames. A flat front-facing material swatch covering the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge. No frame, no border, no scene, no objects, no people, no lettering, no symbols, no decorations. Very low contrast so cream-colored interface text stays readable. No strong spots, seams, checkerboard or repetitive motifs. Opaque image. Asset type: square modal body background. Very dark desaturated olive-black aged leather over old vellum, fine natural pores, delicate irregular fibers and softly mottled soot, organic microscopic wear. Nearly uniform dark olive charcoal tone, very faint warm brown traces. No cracks larger than tiny scratches, no visual center or vignette, no highlight. Designed to cover a large panel without visible tiling.
